articles.title: Container Apps Express Reaches GA on a Newly Generally Available Sandbox Layer
articles.reason: Azure Container Apps Express GA introduces faster, more cost-efficient deployment options relevant for GenAI agentic workflows, but lacks some enterprise features.
articles.summary: Azure Container Apps Express is now generally available, offering rapid, scale-to-zero container hosting on a new microVM-based sandbox layer. While it enables subsecond startup and eliminates environment provisioning, it currently lacks support for custom domains, zone redundancy, Key Vault, OpenTelemetry, and Dapr. For consultants building agentic workflows or RAG systems on Azure, this could reduce costs and speed up prototyping, but may require workarounds for missing enterprise features.
actionable_insights: Evaluate Express for rapid prototyping or cost-sensitive GenAI workloads where advanced networking and observability are not required.
Assess impact of missing features (Key Vault, Dapr, OpenTelemetry) on current and planned multi-agent or RAG deployments.
Consider Express for internal tools or non-production environments to leverage fast startup and scale-to-zero capabilities.
